reason: A long-term memory plugin that stores Markdown memories, manages them through a memory tool, and injects relevant user and workspace memory into prompts across sessions.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 提供跨会话长期记忆，通过 Markdown 文件保存和管理用户级及工作区级记忆，并在会话启动时注入记忆上下文。
summaries.en: Provides cross-session long-term memory for dsh by storing and managing user- and workspace-level Markdown memories and injecting memory context at session start.

capabilities: Reads and writes local Markdown memory files
Injects selected memory index and recent memory content into system prompts
Provides memory add, update, delete, list, read, and Claude Code import actions
Reads existing Claude Code memory files for fallback or import
